record.paper_title: Some open problems in mutual stationarity involving inner model theory: a commentary.
record.context_brief: Alternating cofinality patterns in S_A on [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1}
record.original_question: For A ⊆ ω, define S_A = {X ∈ [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1} | for every m > 1, cf(sup(X ∩ ω_m)) = ω when m ∈ A and cf(sup(X ∩ ω_m)) = ω_1 when m ∉ A}. Assume that A contains successor pairs n, n+1 infinitely often and also omits successor pairs n, n+1 infinitely often. What is the consistency strength of the statement that S_A is stationary for some such A?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an ordinal α, let cf(α) denote its cofinality. Let ℵ_ω denote the ω-th uncountable cardinal, and for each positive integer m let ω_m denote the m-th uncountable cardinal. Let [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1} denote the collection of all subsets X ⊆ ℵ_ω of cardinality ℵ_1. A set 𝒮 ⊆ [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1} is called stationary if for every function F : [ℵ_ω]^{<ω} → ℵ_ω there exists X ∈ 𝒮 with |X| = ℵ_1 that is closed under F.

For each A ⊆ ω, define
  S_A = { X ∈ [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1} : for every integer m > 1, cf(sup(X ∩ ω_m)) = ω if m ∈ A, and cf(sup(X ∩ ω_m)) = ω_1 if m ∉ A }.

Say that A ⊆ ω "infinitely often contains successor pairs" if there are infinitely many n ∈ ω with both n ∈ A and n+1 ∈ A, and "infinitely often omits successor pairs" if there are infinitely many n ∈ ω with both n ∉ A and n+1 ∉ A.

Determine the consistency strength, over ZFC, of the statement: "There exists a set A ⊆ ω that infinitely often contains successor pairs and infinitely often omits successor pairs, such that S_A is stationary in [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1}."
artifact.category_tag: mutual stationarity and inner model theory
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Adolf–Ben-Neria, "Lower consistency bounds for mutual stationarity with divergent cofinalities and limited covering," Israel J. Math., 2022; arXiv:1908.01332) establishes lower bounds for mutual stationarity with alternating/divergent cofinality patterns and reduces dependence on covering, but the exact consistency strength for patterns A that infinitely often both contain and omit successor pairs is not pinned down. No source found establishing a matching upper and lower bound, so the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Lower consistency bounds for mutual stationarity with divergent cofinalities and limited covering
status_evidence.snippet: Improves previous findings on the consistency strength of mutually stationary sequences with divergent cofinalities, allowing sequences in which sets concentrating on points of countable cofinality appear infinitely often.
status_evidence.claim: Provides lower bounds but not a tight consistency strength for the specified alternating pattern.

status_evidence.title: [1908.01332] Lower consistency bounds for mutual stationarity with divergent cofinalities and limited covering
status_evidence.snippet: Lower consistency bounds for mutual stationarity with divergent cofinalities.
status_evidence.claim: Related lower bounds exist; exact strength for the successor-pair pattern not determined.
